|---|---|---|
| Automated test-sequence integration and remote controllability | AI-assisted testing is described as agentic AI for end-to-end test planning, smart execution of complex scenarios, DUT management and result analysis. [37] | SMM100A supports SCPI remote control, LAN, USB, GPIB, VNC, FTP and HUMS interfaces for automation. [25] |
| High-quality mmWave / RF vector signal generation | R&S work with JIO and ODMs focused on 3GPP mmWave-related testing and precise tuning of EVM and signal integrity after signal up-conversion. [39] | SMW200A RF path A covers up to 67 GHz and supports internal baseband I/Q modulation bandwidth up to 2 GHz. [32] |
| Wide modulation bandwidth for modern wireless and AI-connected devices | Generative AI services are growing across connected devices such as smartphones, AI glasses and robots. [40] | SMM100A supports up to 44 GHz frequency range and up to 2 GHz internal RF modulation bandwidth. [20] |
| Internal real-time signal generation and ARB waveform generation | AI-related test automation needs smart execution of complex test scenarios. [37] | SMW200A can configure up to eight baseband generators with real-time coder and ARB. [32] |
| MIMO, fading and channel emulation | Complex scenario execution is a stated AI-assisted test focus. [37] | SMW200A supports up to eight signal sources, up to 64 fading channels and integrated fading with up to 800 MHz channel emulation bandwidth. [32] |
| EVM, modulation quality and signal-integrity-oriented generation | Raw evidence explicitly identifies EVM and signal integrity after signal up-conversion as optimization focus areas. [39] | SMM100A is specified with excellent SSB phase noise, EVM and ACPR/ACLR performance. [20] |
| Noise, interference and impairment generation | AI-assisted test result analysis includes verifying objectives, pass/fail results and root-cause analysis. [37] | SMW200A provides AWGN, enhanced noise generation and notched-signal options. [34] |
| Frequency-response correction, predistortion and linearization | Raw evidence highlights precise tuning after up-conversion, which makes controlled RF-chain correction relevant. [39] | SMW200A options include AM/AM and AM/PM predistortion, user-defined frequency response correction and RF linearization. [34] |
| Log- and result-analysis readiness in automated workflows | AI-assisted testing includes analyzing test-case logs for objectives, pass/fail results, root cause and signaling-log protocol issues. [37] | CMX500 provides receiver and transmitter test functions with RF generators and RF analyzers routed through multiple RF ports. [7] |
【推論】For AI-connected-device testing, the most relevant signal-generation stack is wideband RF vector generation, standards waveforms, MIMO/fading, impairment generation, and automation interfaces, because the raw passages emphasize connected AI devices, 3GPP/mmWave testing, complex scenario execution and automated result analysis. [37][39][40]

| Code | Name / description | Order No. | 原文 requires / 重點 |

| `R&S®SMW-K544` | User-defined frequency response correction | `1414.3707.02` | Requires `R&S®SMW-B13/-B13T/-B13XT`。 |
| `R&S®SMW-K546` | Digital Doherty | `1414.6487.02` | Requires two `K541`、two baseband generators、two RF paths、`R&S®SMW-B90`。 |
| `R&S®SMW-K548` | Crest factor reduction | `1414.6641.02` | Requires `R&S®SMW-B9/-B10`。 |
| `R&S®SMW-K551` | Slow I/Q | `1413.9724.02` | Requires `B10` + `K18` 或 `B9` + `K19`。 |
| `R&S®SMW-K555` | Bandwidth extension | `1414.6229.02` | Requires two `B9`、two `K527`；clock rate up to `4.8 GHz`；bandwidth up to `4 GHz`。 |
| `R&S®SMW-K575` | RF linearization | `1434.8379.02` | Requires at least one `B10` or `B9`。 |
| `R&S®SMW-K556` | Customized digital input | `1434.8310.02` | 每個 option 需一個 `B9`；HS DIG I/Q；data rate `50 Gbit/s`。 |
| `R&S®SMW-K810` | Enhanced noise generation | `1414.6341.02` | Requires `R&S®SMW-K62`。 |
| `R&S®SMW-K811` | Notched signals | `1414.6364.02` | Requires `B10` or `B9`；最多 `25` 個 band-stop filters。 |

R&S SMW200A › 產品定位與架構
依 [[SMW200A_specs_en_3606-8037-22_v3100]]（Version 31.00，May 2026）與 [[SMW200A_config-guide_en_3606-8037-92_v0600]]（Version 06.00，May 2024）：

- [[R&S SMW200A]] 可從 single-path vector signal generator 擴充到 multichannel [[MIMO]] receiver tester。
- 支援最多 `8` 個 signal sources 與最多 `64` 個 fading channels。
- 可連接 [[R&S SGT100A]] signal generator modules，提供最多 `8` 條 RF paths。
- 最多可在 `2` 個 internal baseband modules 上配置 `8` 個 baseband generators，具 real-time coder 與 ARB。
- 單機可配置最多兩個 internal RF paths：RF path A 為 mandatory，RF path B 為 optional second RF path。
- Baseband section 分成 standard baseband section 與 wideband baseband section；standard baseband 最高 `160 MHz` RF modulation bandwidth，wideband baseband 最高 `2 GHz` RF modulation bandwidth。
- 可選 integrated fading section，channel emulation bandwidth 最高 `800 MHz`；最多可安裝 `4` 個 fading modules，提供最多 `64` 個 logical faders。
- 單一儀器可實作 MIMO fading scenarios：`2x2`、`3x3`、`4x4`、`8x4`、`4x8`、`2x4x4`。
- Path-specific、baseband-specific 與 fading/MIMO software options 採 floating license concept；若同一 feature 需同時在兩個 paths 或兩個 baseband generators 使用，通常需安裝兩份對應 option。

R&S SMW200A › Wideband baseband
- `R&S®SMW-B9` arbitrary waveform mode：waveform length `1 sample to 256 Msample`；with `K515` 到 `2 Gsample`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` sample rate：`400 Hz to 600 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `400 Hz to 1200 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `400 Hz to 2400 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9` RF bandwidth：`500 MHz`；with `K525` 為 `1000 MHz`；with `K527` 為 `2000 MHz`。
- `R&S®SMW-B9F` 詳細 GNSS 規格見 `GNSS simulation for Rohde & Schwarz vector signal generators specifications`，文件 `PD 3607.6896.22`。

R&S SMCV100B › Unresolved
- 來源開頭標示 `Version 17.00，September 2025`，文件資訊頁標示文件日期 `August 2025`；需人工確認正式文件日期。
- 來源未標示價格。
- Warranty/service options 未列具體 service plan order number；extended periods 只寫 contact Rohde & Schwarz sales office。
- Digital standards options 多數只列 option code、order number 與部分 requires 關係；未標示 requires/excludes 者本頁不自行推導。
- `Pulse modulation` 的 on/off ratio 摘錄為 `> 80`，來源摘錄未標示單位。
- `R&S®SMCVB-K285` LTE Release 10 的 order number 來源列為 `1434.4415.02`，與 `R&S®SMCVB-K261` Multicarrier CW signal generation 相同；本頁照抄來源，不自行判定是否為原文錯字。
- 來源摘要為分段萃取重點，不是完整逐頁文字；報價前應回查 [[SMCV100B_specs_en_3608-0627-22_v1700]] 對應 raw 原文。

R&S SMCV100B › Signal performance for digital standards and modulation systems
3GPP FDD with `R&S®SMCVB-K242` option：EVM `1 DPCH`、RMS、frequency `1800 MHz to 2200 MHz` 為 `< 0.8%`、`0.3% measured`；ACLR test model 1、`64 DPCH`、frequency `1800 MHz to 2200 MHz`、average channel power `≤ 0 dBm`、optimization mode fast、temperature `+18 °C to +33 °C` 時，`5 MHz offset` 為 `< –63 dBc`、`–65 dBc typical`，`10 MHz offset` 為 `< –67 dBc`、`–69 dBc typical`。

Custom digital modulation with `R&S®SMCVB-K199` option：2FSK/4FSK deviation error 在 symbol rate up to `2 MHz` 為 `0.4% measured`，up to `10 MHz` 為 `1.2% measured`；MSK phase error bit rate up to `10 MHz` 為 `0.3° measured`；EVM symbol rate up to `5 MHz` 為 `0.5% RMS measured`，up to `20 MHz` 為 `2.0% RMS measured`。

R&S CMX500 › RF ports 與 routing
- RF Com 1、RF Com 2：simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing；2 × SnapN；RF input/output to DUT。
- RF In 1、RF In 2：transmitter testing；2 × SnapN；RF input from DUT。
- RF Out 1 to RF Out 4：receiver testing；4 × SnapN；RF output to DUT。
- Receiver test functions：四個 RF generators（其中兩個在 GPRF mode）可 routing 到 RF Com 1、RF Com 2、RF Out 1 to RF Out 4。

# R&S Key Involvement: 3GPP Related Testing
Deep Collaboration: R&S worked with JIO and ODMs to verify 3GPP mmWave-related test items.
Optimization Focus: Precise tuning of EVM (Modulation Quality) and signal integrity after signal up-conversion.

Generative AI uses large language models (LLMs) to create user-requested content, including text, images and videos. As LLMs, computing capabilities and related applications continue to evolve, the use of generative AI services across a wide range of connected devices, including smartphones, AI glasses and robots, is growing rapidly. However, testing solutions for generative AI remain limited, and the industry still lacks mature metrics and standardized test frameworks for evaluating user experience. Organizations such as 3GPP and GTI are actively conducting related research.
